title: A novel optical chemical sensor for germanium determination in food and environmental samples
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,2801-2815
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08967K, Paper
Open Access

Alaa S. Amin, Mostafa Y. Nassar
A colorimetric optode for Ge4+ detection was developed by incorporating DMTMP and Aliquat-336 into CTA matrix plasticized with TEHP. The transparent optode quantitatively preconcentrates Ge4+, inducing a distinct color change (λmax = 545 nm).
